scenarios.scenario: Navigate between a file's folder and its parent

scenario_steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
a saved part with a preview is selected in a child folder
the dialog starts in `fixtures/cad/document-opening/folder-navigation/NativeParent/NativeChild` with `Navigation-Part.opd` selected
the user chooses Up to the parent folder
the parent folder contents are displayed
the child folder is highlighted in the list
the file name field retains the part name
the preview area shows a placeholder for the selected folder
the user chooses Back
the child folder contents are displayed again
the file name field and preview display the previously selected part
the user chooses Forward
the parent folder contents are displayed again
the child folder is highlighted

scenarios.scenario: Open a selected folder while a file name is retained

scenario_steps.name: the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software
the file name field retains the name of a part in a child folder
the parent folder displays that child folder
`fixtures/cad/document-opening/folder-navigation/NativeParent` contains a `NativeChild` folder with `Navigation-Part.opd`
the user selects the child folder in the file list
the user chooses Open
the dialog remains open and displays the child folder contents
the file name field still contains the part name
the part preview is displayed
no new document tab is created

scenarios.scenario: Open a different drawing by double-clicking its row

scenario_steps.name: writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder
the user opens each drawing, inserts a base view referencing the staged OpenPart.opd, saves it and closes it
an assembly document is active in the MCAD Software
the Open dialog displays two saved drawings in a folder
the first drawing is selected
the second drawing has a sheet, border and saved views and is not already open
`fixtures/cad/single-occurrence.oad` is active and `OpenDrawingA.odd` plus `OpenDrawingB.odd` are closed
the user double-clicks the second drawing's row
the Open dialog closes
the second drawing opens in a new active document tab
its sheet, border and saved views are displayed
the assembly tab remains available
